title: Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant: Part of the Reserve Kept in the Down Payment, by Loan Program
content:
Under a Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant the part of the borrower's reserve kept in the down payment is worked out by loan program, each in its own way, from the borrower's Mortgage Loan File, its latest Closing Disclosure, the grant's ledger and, on a HomeReady file, the Appraisal Order on the file.

**On an FHA or VA file** (Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed or Larkspur VA 30-Year Fixed), the closing costs the borrower still pays at closing count toward the reserve first, these being the nonrecurring closing costs on the latest Closing Disclosure less the seller and agent concessions recorded on the loan file and less the grant's closing-cost entries, never below zero, and only the rest of the reserve, never below zero, is kept in the down payment.

**On a HomeReady file** (Larkspur HomeReady 30-Year Fixed), the charges the borrower paid before closing (the appraisal charges collected on the file's appraisal order and the up-front application and credit report fees paid on the loan file) count toward the reserve first, and only the rest of the reserve, never below zero, is kept in the down payment.

**On any other program**, the whole reserve is kept in the down payment.

| Loan program | Counted toward the reserve first | Part of the reserve kept in the down payment |
|---|---|---|
| FHA or VA | closing costs the borrower still pays at closing | reserve less those costs, never below zero |
| HomeReady | charges paid before closing | reserve less those charges, never below zero |
| any other | nothing | the whole reserve |

### Worked example (hypothetical figures, reserve of 1500.00)

| File | Figures | Part kept in the down payment |
|---|---|---|
| Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed | nonrecurring closing costs 7000.00, concessions 4000.00, grant closing-cost entries 2400.00: the borrower still pays 600.00 | 900.00 |
| Larkspur VA 30-Year Fixed | nonrecurring closing costs 5000.00, concessions 3000.00, grant closing-cost entries 2400.00: the borrower still pays 0.00 | 1500.00 |
| Larkspur HomeReady 30-Year Fixed | appraisal charges collected 600.00, up-front fees paid 100.00 | 800.00 |
| Larkspur Conventional 30-Year Fixed | — | 1500.00 |
